home.new.noRootHint: Set a project directory in Settings first
home.open.title: Open Project
home.open.rootEmpty: No projects here yet. Copy a project folder into the default project directory and it will show up automatically.
home.open.noRootHint: Projects in that directory will show up here once set
generate.title: Generate Assets
history.title: History
history.removeDraftHint: This draft can no longer be sliced afterwards; if a grid image was generated, that file is removed too.
history.removeCommittedHint: This record is already sliced: the sprite files, the grid image and this record are all removed.
history.railNoProject: Open a project and its generation history appears here — click a thumbnail to jump back to that run
history.committedHint: Saved with the current slice settings: files above, and the grid sheet with its slice state kept below. You can tweak and slice again (overwrites same-named files) or regenerate.
history.restoredHint: Reviewing a committed batch: parameters and grid image are loaded. You may re-slice and save again (overwrites the batch's files).
settings.title: Settings
settings.apiBaseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible base e.g. https://ai.gitee.com/v1, or a full image endpoint
settings.imageEndpointHint: OpenAI-compatible image generation endpoint: fill in the API URL and API Key, then choose a suitable image model.
settings.paHint: An independent LLM config used to auto-generate the prompts for image generation (overall description / details / asset names / style), separate from the image model.
settings.dirPickerNoIpc: Running in browser preview mode — directory picking requires the desktop app (native dialog)
role.subject: Subject Reference
generate.detailTemplateHint: Click chips to stack detail prompts; click again to remove, or clear all
buildStamp.tip: Build time of this window (local). If clearly older than now, you are running a stale build - fully quit and relaunch via start.cmd.
message.staleBridge: The UI has been updated but the desktop process is still the old version. Fully quit and restart the app.
assets.title: Asset Library
assets.subtitle: {{count}} records
assets.empty: No records yet. A record appears here automatically after you generate a grid image.
assets.state.emptyHint: Only the settings were saved; no image generated yet
assets.selectHint: Click to select · double-click to enlarge
assets.useAsReferenceHint: Send slice {{index}} / {{count}} to the generate page as a reference image
assets.removeSlicedHint: This record is already sliced: deleting removes the sprite files, the grid sheet and this record.
assets.removeGridHint: This record only has a grid sheet and is not sliced: deleting removes the sheet and this record.
assets.removeEmptyHint: This record only holds generation settings: deleting removes this record.
assets.noDirHint: No default export directory set. Configure it in Settings to enable Copy PNG.
generate.cellNames: Asset name list (optional, one per line, in grid order)
generate.paBubble: Prompt Assistant: generate prompts from current asset params and your natural-language description
generate.paHint: Based on your current asset parameters (type / count, etc.), describe the style, effect and objects you want in natural language, then generate the overall description, object details, asset names and custom style in one click and auto-fill the form.
generate.paContext: Based on current params: type {{type}} · count {{count}} (used as generation constraints)
generate.paNaturalPlaceholder: e.g. cyberpunk style, enemies with neon glow, rainy night city skyline in the background…
generate.paNeedConfig: Configure the Prompt Assistant (its own API / Key) in Settings first.
generate.paNoFields: Select at least one field to generate.
generate.paNaturalEmpty: Please enter a natural-language description first
generate.paConfigMissing: Prompt Assistant is not configured. Fill in Base URL / Key / Model in Settings.
generate.paRawHint: The model did not return JSON as expected, so it cannot be parsed automatically. Copy the raw result below and paste it into the matching input fields manually.
generate.draftEmpty: Fill in parameters on the left, then generate the grid image
generate.sliceHint: Equal-slice fallback: the sheet is cut by fixed column slots of cols × rows and only the first 'count' slots are taken. The AI draws left-aligned into the slots, so this usually needs no change; regenerate the sheet if unsatisfied.
generate.autoDetected: Auto-located {{count}} sprites by content (green boxes): slicing follows each sprite's real boundary instead of an equal grid — works even when characters are drawn off-center or the last row is partial.
generate.autoDetectedPartial: Auto-located only {{count}} sprites by content (green boxes), fewer than the requested {{expected}}: the sheet actually contains just this many. Slicing will produce {{count}} files with no empty slots; regenerate the sheet if you need {{expected}}.
generate.autoDetectedExtra: Auto-located {{count}} sprites by content (green boxes), more than the requested {{expected}}: the sheet actually contains this many. Slicing will produce {{count}} files and keep the extra sprites.
generate.autoFallback: Could not reliably separate every sprite this time (spacing too tight or layout drift). Saving will automatically fall back to equal slicing; you can turn off smart align and adjust manually, or regenerate the sheet.
freecut.title: Free cropping
freecut.restoreHint: Overwrite current manual data with smart-align detection results
freecut.rectHint: Hold left button to drag a rectangle; release to preview, keep if satisfied. Click a box to select; drag its vertices (red dots) or interior to refine. Right-drag to pan, wheel to zoom.
freecut.polygonHint: Left-click to add vertices, double-click to close (ends auto-connected). Right-click to undo the last point, right-drag to pan, wheel to zoom.
freecut.polygonDrawingHint: {{n}} vertices added, keep clicking or double-click to close
freecut.empty: No slices yet — draw regions on the canvas
freecut.thumbnailNote: Double-click a thumbnail to view full size; click to highlight on canvas; deleting also removes the box.
generate.styleCustom: Custom style description (injected as art style)
generate.styleCustomEmpty: Fill in the style description, or switch back to a preset.
generate.otherHint: Other: the whole canvas is output as one artwork (suitable for illustrations, single key visuals, etc.). Always 1 image, no multi-cell slicing.
generate.configLoadedHint: Historical parameters loaded — generate now or keep adjusting
